Resolves #21903

🌿 A new example no longer needs a script of clicks and selectors to get its cover.

`validateCaptureRecipes` stopped refusing a covered record without a recipe: such a record gets a landing entry, in any family, and `capture()` takes its cover from the frame a visitor lands on. One 960×540 viewport at device scale 1⅓ (Clio's ruling from a board of nine captures, below), the whole frame, opened with `?theme=neo-theme-neo-dark` as the dark catalog opens it, captured once the network is idle, a configured theme shows on `<body>` or inside it, the app's view has mounted, and the DOM has held still for a second. A frame that opens on a light theme (an example that ignores `?theme=`) fails instead of becoming the dark cover. No per-example selector, step or size. `--record` reaches a covered card in any family; a run of all recipes or of one `--family` keeps to the families the manifest declares. The README states the rule: a cover is the frame a visitor lands on, the 82 recipes are frozen, and an example whose cover needs a state starts in it, in its own code.

The frozen manifest also leaves the Portal's data folder: it moves to `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.json`, beside the only script that reads it, and `.npmignore` keeps its 79 KB out of the published package (`npm pack --dry-run`: not packed; `check-package-contents`: OK).

Evidence: L3 (real captures from the dev server on this branch) → L3 required (AC-2). Residual: none.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | CI-covered: `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` pins a covered record without a recipe to one landing entry with the fixed defaults (and `--record` selects it); a card in a family no recipe covers gets one that `--record` alone reaches, while a run of all or of one family keeps to the declared families; a recipe needs a declared family and replaces the landing entry; a catalog id that cannot name its cover file is refused, as a recipe's is; an external-origin record and a tile get none. Red-proof: `dev`'s `validateCaptureRecipes` throws `covered record has no recipe in this family` on the same input. |
| AC-2 | Outside CI, recipes removed locally for each run (not committed): `scheduler-big-data` captured its landing frame (1280×720, 142,432 bytes, the full plan). At `12811f17b5`: `dock-layouts` captured on `neo-theme-neo-dark` (its theme sits on `<body>`); `markdown` failed with `opened on neo-theme-neo-light, not on neo-theme-neo-dark or neo-theme-dark` (it ignores `?theme=`); `gallery` failed with `landing: the frame never held still for 1000 ms` (it animates). At `5fea30afce`, with no manifest edit: `--record state-provider` (family `state`, outside the declared families) captured on `neo-theme-dark` (1280×720, 52,715 bytes); `--record offscreen-canvas` (family `platform`) failed with `the frame never held still`, like `gallery`. A probe page that sets its theme on `<body>` at once and mounts its view at 2,800 ms: `a8762cc685`'s wait returned at 1,521 ms with no view mounted, `5fea30afce`'s at 4,032 ms with the view. CI-covered since `c75f9a1cb6`: `test/playwright/component/buildScripts/docs/CaptureLanding.spec.mjs` opens such a page (view mounted after 2 s) and `landingReady` must return with the view there; with the mount wait removed it fails (`Expected: 1, Received: 0`). |
| AC-3 | `buildScripts/README.md`: the paragraph that opens the capture section. |
| AC-4 | CI-covered: `CaptureExamples.spec.mjs` "a component record the frozen list does not name is a tile at its own size, after the listed ones" (and a component record without an `examples/` path is refused). Red-proof: the previous head's script returns only the listed tile. On the real manifest and catalog: 51 tiles, as before. |

## Deltas from ticket

- The readiness gained the network-idle wait after the blank first capture (AC-2), and since `12811f17b5` it waits for one of the page's `Neo.config.themes` on `<body>` or inside it. The old substring match for `neo-theme-` matched the theme switch's own `neo-theme-switcher` class on a body viewport.
- A landing frame that shows no dark theme fails (`12811f17b5`). Measured on the 29 step-less recipes' examples against `dev`: 15 honour `?theme=` in both schemes, 10 always open dark, and 4 always open light (markdown, list-animate, graph-scene, am-charts). Those four would otherwise have written a light frame as their dark cover once their recipes went.
- The manifest moves out of `apps/portal/resources/data` and out of the package (Clio's fork A, from the operator's remark that capture input does not belong in the Portal's data); its path follows in the script, both specs and the README.
- Euclid's review at `a8762cc685` (A2A e0976c6a, then review 6013161030) found two AC-2 misses, fixed in `5fea30afce` and `c75f9a1cb6`: `--record` found no entry for an eligible card outside the declared families (Task Worker, File Explorer), and a theme set on `<body>` by a stylesheet before mount let the wait pass on an empty frame. The wait now also needs the app's view (`viewMounted`: an element child of `<body>` that is shown and covers part of the frame; the main thread's measuring nodes are hidden or parked off it).
- An example whose DOM never holds still (a live counter, an animation) is refused, as the README says. Whether a moment of such an example is a cover is a question for its own leaf, not this rule.

## Test Evidence

The AC-2 captures above. At `c75f9a1cb6`: `CaptureExamples` and the Portal unit specs, 175 passed; `CaptureLanding` (component tier), 1 passed.

**The landing-viewport board** (linked by commit `aee7fe2777`, removed again in `f1f3f77996`): three records with their recipes deleted locally, captured through this branch's CLI at 1280×720, 960×540 and 640×360, beside today's cover from `neomjs/pages` `main`, every cell 445 px wide as on a card.

![Three records at three landing viewports beside today's covers](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/blob/aee7fe2777fd58e5e0293eef5514e663224b1298/review-evidence/21903/landing-viewport-board.png?raw=true)

Frame critique: at 1280×720 the titles do not read at card width; at 640×360 the scheduler's toolbar wraps and the board shows one lane; at 960×540 all three keep their desktop layout and readable titles, which is Clio's pick. `grid-countries` lands on Neo Light at every size because its dark cover today comes from a scripted click; the `?theme=` link makes it land dark once #21907 (catalog theme) merges.
